request.prompt:
Create a production animation source sheet for the exact original heavy armored boss in the reference. ONE character design, KURTZ, not a generic thin knight: enormous spiked steel shoulder plates, broad blackened engraved heavy chest armor, closed ornate horn-pointed steel helmet with a dark slit, scarlet cloth around neck, long torn deep red cape, broad long steel greatsword held in anatomical right hand, armored boots and articulated gauntlets. Match the supplied reference silhouette and materials without adding a shield. Game illustration quality, detailed painted sprites for an isometric top-down action RPG, crisp complete character, no glow, no shadow, no background, no text or labels. Transparent background.
Exactly 15 separate full-body sprites in a strict 5 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS grid, equal cells. Canvas 1536x1024. All poses face SOUTH toward the viewer, with camera looking slightly down from above; same fixed camera, same perspective, same proportions and costume throughout. Leave at least 20px clear empty gutter inside EVERY cell, keep the entire sword, cape and boots inside its own cell. Do not draw grid lines. Ground baseline and character scale consistent. Do not overlap cells.
Read order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: cell1 IDLE A relaxed guarded planted stance; cell2 IDLE B subtle chest/cape breath, same ground; cell3 RUN0 anatomical RIGHT boot planted forward, LEFT boot behind raised; cell4 RUN1 right leg sole pushing off, left knee coming forward; cell5 RUN2 airborne transition left knee forwards, right leg trailing; cell6 RUN3 anatomical LEFT boot planted forward, RIGHT boot behind raised; cell7 RUN4 left sole pushing off, right knee coming forward; cell8 RUN5 airborne right knee forward left trailing. The RUN six poses MUST show the opposite leg clearly taking its own contact at frames0 and3, not six versions of one raised knee. A heavy committed run with restrained vertical bounce and cape follow-through.
cell9 ATTACK0 broad sword raised back, knees loading; cell10 ATTACK1 forward weight transfer and descending blade; cell11 ATTACK2 heavy forward contact with blade fully extended, shoulders rotated; cell12 ATTACK3 recovery sword low, body settling. This is four meaningfully distinct anatomical poses, never a translated copy.
cell13 HIT0 chest recoils with sword pulled close; cell14 HIT1 maximum recoil with cape lag and bent knee; cell15 HIT2 recovering to guarded stance. All remain SOUTH camera; limb positions change but never rotate the camera. Match reference color and body mass. Full isolated sprite per cell, no particles or visual effects.
